turns.content: Suppose the solar pp-III branch stopped about 8.5 minutes ago while pp-I, pp-II, and CNO reactions continued. Taking the Sun-Earth travel time into account, should pp-III neutrinos be included in the flux arriving now?
For the 700-800 and 800-900 keV bands, identify the remaining solar-neutrino sources; use the pp endpoint near 420 keV, the pep line at 1.44 MeV, and a CNO continuum through this window.
The main 7Be line is at 862 keV with integrated flux of order 10^9 cm^-2 s^-1. Which band contains it, and does the other band have a comparable strong line?
Estimate each band flux using that line and a CNO continuum of order 10^8 cm^-2 s^-1 MeV^-1, corresponding to about 10^7 cm^-2 s^-1 per 100-keV band.
Compute the order-of-magnitude ratio of the integrated 700-800 keV flux to the 800-900 keV flux and state its approximate uncertainty.
Check how the discrete 7Be line and smooth CNO continuum enter the integrals, and why stopping pp-III does not materially change this ratio.
Report the ratio and the dominant source in each band.
